title: ai chat assistant data retrieval accuracy

title: rag data ingestion and embedding generation
description: Test the RAG data ingestion script to ensure it correctly processes JSON/TXT data, generates embeddings using Xenova Transformers.js, and successfully updates the TiDB vector database without errors.

title: material battle module comparison accuracy

title: rules and guidelines panel content display
description: Verify that the Rules & Guidelines Panel correctly displays all operational policies, shipping information, and FAQs for user reference.

title: chat assistant response performance
description: Measure the response time of the AI Chat Assistant to ensure user interactions with the chatbot are within acceptable performance thresholds.

title: admin pricing data update workflow

title: search and filter functionality in pricing catalog

title: proposal copy functionality
